exposure: Trans-abdominal multifetal pregnancy reduction (MFPR) using intracardiac potassium chloride (KCl) injection
outcome: Number of fetal reduction procedures carried out
Pregnancy reduction outcomes (e.g., triplet to twin)
Inadvertent demise of a second fetus
Safety and effectiveness of the procedure
cohort: 108 patients with higher-order multiple pregnancies undergoing trans-abdominal multifetal pregnancy reduction in a private hospital.
finding: Ultrasound-guided trans-abdominal fetal reduction performed between the seventh and twelfth weeks of gestation was found to be safe and effective.
gest_age: 7 to 15 weeks of gestation at the time of the procedure
